propositions: T5c produces 288 advisory findings in 7 days with zero blocks, emitting findings about credentials and assets the plan does not modify or touch (e.g., Gerrit HTTP password rotation on SSM-destroy-only plans).
Same-round near-duplicate findings are emitted for identical (surface, defect) pairs within a single review round (e.g., ticket 9e76 produced two findings both demanding temp-key-file deletion).
The plan_review_T5c.md prompt lacks an explicit in-plan-asset scope rule requiring that findings must name the plan section/step creating, modifying, or transmitting the asset at issue.
The prompt lacks a same-round dedup rule stating one finding per (surface, defect) pair, with additional criteria angles folded into that finding's text rather than emitted separately.
Acceptance criteria require regeneration of the derived prompt index if the build requires it, routing.json byte-identity preservation, and CI prompt-drift gate passage.
